Loss report: argo -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider argo (dependency, eventSource, sensor, trigger) is not written to the Concourse file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider argo (dependency, eventSource, sensor, trigger) is not written to the Concourse file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag (a job cannot trigger on a push and on a tag: the tag resource has no version on a branch push, so the job would never start; the job runs on push only)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.artifacts: workspace artifact handed from task to task (inputs and outputs of the same name) (only within one job; a job with no script step writes no workspace)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
